checkIns.notes: First week in. Felt rough getting back into a routine but finished all three sessions.
Week 2 done. Deadlift numbers went up. Sleep still inconsistent.
Felt more settled this week. Hit all five sessions. Schedule is starting to feel normal.
Rough couple days. Work schedule shifted. Missed two sessions. Not a failure — just adjusting.
Back on track. Did a short conditioning session to reset. Feeling more like myself.
Good session this morning. Numbers holding. Coach note helped refocus the week.
Low energy day. Did mobility work instead of the main lift. Still showed up.
Best sleep in weeks. Hit morning session before shift. Felt dialed in.

coachingNotes.author: D. Harlow
coachingNotes.subject: Week 2 check-in — R. Vance
coachingNotes.content: Member completed all five sessions. Deadlift form is solid — cue on bracing before the pull. Sleep is still under target. Discussed sleep window consistency. No changes to programming this week. Goal: hit 7 hours four nights out of seven.

coachingNotes.author: D. Harlow
coachingNotes.subject: Week 3 programming adjustment
coachingNotes.content: Increased squat volume by one working set based on week 2 performance. Mobility work added to Tuesday and Thursday sessions. Member should complete the hip and ankle circuit before main lifts. Purpose is to build durable movement, not flexibility for its own sake.

coachingNotes.author: D. Harlow
coachingNotes.subject: Schedule disruption — recovery protocol
coachingNotes.content: Member flagged two missed sessions due to shift change. Advised: do not try to catch up by stacking missed days. Return to the current week's programming and finish what's left. Consistency over volume. Reminder logged for next week's check-in.

coachingNotes.author: K. Boone
coachingNotes.subject: Intake note — app-003
coachingNotes.content: Firefighter applicant is requesting in-person sessions. Region confirmed as Midwest. Forwarded to coach availability check. No coach confirmed yet. Member notified of expected 5–7 day response window.

coachingNotes.author: D. Harlow
coachingNotes.subject: Accountability follow-up — app-001
coachingNotes.content: Week 3 momentum is good. Member is using the programming correctly and self-reporting honestly. Biggest current obstacle is sleep. Next phase: introduce one nutrition habit — consistent protein timing around training. No overhaul, just one change.
